source='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vertical = [c for c in range(width)
                if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(height))]
    vertical_set = set(vertical)
    horizontal = [r for r in range(height)
                  if grid[r][0] != 0 and len({grid[r][c] for c in range(width) if c not in vertical_set}) == 1
                  and grid[r][next(c for c in range(width) if c not in vertical_set)] != 0]

    def representatives(size, separators):
        chosen = []
        start = 0
        for line in separators:
            if start < line:
                chosen.append(start)
            chosen.append(line)
            start = line + 1
        if start < size:
            chosen.append(start)
        return chosen

    rows = representatives(height, horizontal)
    cols = representatives(width, vertical)
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
'''
